name: kondi-telegram-mcp
description: MCP server providing Telegram Bot API tools

tools.name: telegram_send_message
tools.description: Send a text message to a Telegram chat.

tools.name: telegram_get_updates
tools.description: Receive incoming updates (messages, edits, etc.) from the Telegram bot.

tools.name: telegram_send_photo
tools.description: Send a photo to a Telegram chat by URL.

tools.name: telegram_get_chat
tools.description: Get information about a Telegram chat.

tools.name: telegram_get_me
tools.description: Get basic information about the bot.
